groups.prompt: Profile each supplied input independently using its policy. Return a snake_case result for every input keyed by its case_id, mapping candidate 0 to the candidate fields and root rowCounts.validInWindow and archetype to the corresponding output fields. Use null for undefined values. Do not execute code, use tools, infer missing fields, or include explanations.
